full_prompt_en: A square cartoon illustration shows two grinning boys seated on a pale ground beside a small orange cat, all set against a softly textured teal backdrop. Empty teal space fills the upper corners and gives the compact group room to breathe. On the left, a brown-haired boy with a large swept fringe sits with knees raised. He wears a mustard-yellow shirt, rolled blue-green trousers, and red canvas shoes with white toes. Both hands hold a dark game controller above his knees. His wide oval eyes turn toward the boy beside him, and his open smile shows bright teeth. At the center-right, a blond boy with thick black rectangular glasses sits close against him. A red short-sleeved top, dark shorts, white socks with green bands, and red-and-white sneakers make his clothes distinct. He folds his hands over his bent knees and flashes a broad toothy smile toward the right. Beside his shoes, the orange cat sits upright with triangular ears, half-closed eyes, a tiny white fang, and a striped tail curling upward along the far right. Strong dark outlines and soft brown shadow bands shape their faces, hair, limbs, and clothing without losing the simple animation forms. The background has faint grain and worn speckles around the edges, while the floor is only a slightly lighter green plane with soft shadows beneath the figures. Small signature-like marks near the lower corners are not legible enough to reproduce. Light is gentle and frontal, brightening the eyes and faces and placing compact shadows under the shoes and cat. The overall composition is friendly and tightly grouped, balancing exaggerated expressions and rounded silhouettes against a quiet open teal field.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形卡通插画呈现两名咧嘴笑的男孩坐在浅色地面上，旁边是一只小橙猫，背景为带轻微肌理的青绿色。空旷青绿空间填满上方两角，给紧凑人物群留下呼吸余地。左侧棕发男孩有宽大的横扫刘海，双膝抬起坐着。他穿芥黄色上衣、卷起裤脚的蓝绿色裤子和白鞋头的红色帆布鞋。两只手把一只深色游戏手柄举在膝上。椭圆大眼睛转向旁边男孩，张口笑时露出亮白牙齿。中央偏右，戴粗黑方框眼镜的金发男孩挨着他坐。红色短袖上衣、深色短裤、带绿条的白袜和红白运动鞋让衣着分明。他双手叠在弯起的膝盖上，朝右露出宽阔的露齿笑容。鞋旁的橙色猫直坐着，有三角耳、半闭眼、一颗小白尖牙，条纹尾巴沿最右侧向上弯。坚实深色轮廓和柔和棕色影带塑出脸、头发、手脚与衣服，同时保留简洁动画造型。背景在边缘带有细微颗粒和磨旧斑点，地面只是稍浅的绿色平面，人物下方留有软影。下方两角细小如签名的痕迹不足以辨认，不逐字呈现。光温柔地从正面照来，提亮眼睛与面孔，在鞋和猫下留下紧凑阴影。整体构图亲切而聚拢，以夸张表情和圆润剪影平衡安静开放的青绿色域。
style_prompt_en: The cartoon illustration uses elastic rounded geometry, expressive dark contour lines, and softly shaded blocks of color. Muted teal and dusty green provide calm breadth, while mustard, red, warm peach, brown, and cream gather in a compact focal cluster. Simplified forms stretch and swell at key points, but small solid shadows keep them grounded. Eyes and other bright accents are sharply legible against thicker outlines; less important internal detail is reduced to a few confident strokes. Subtle grain and worn speckling soften the broad background, while the focal color remains comparatively clean and saturated. Light is even and gently frontal, with small localized shadows rather than dramatic directional contrast. A low clustered arrangement leaves generous open space above, emphasizing the playful shape rhythm. The overall effect is warm and animated, with a few strong color notes and clear silhouettes carrying the energy.
style_prompt_zh: 这种卡通插画使用有弹性的圆润几何、富表情的深色轮廓线和柔和塑形的色块。低饱和青绿与灰绿提供安静宽面，芥黄、红色、暖桃色、棕色和奶油色聚成紧凑焦点群。简化形体在关键处伸展、膨胀，小而坚实的阴影仍让它们站稳。明亮重音在较粗轮廓前清晰可辨，较不重要的内部细节归纳为少数自信笔触。微妙颗粒和磨旧斑点软化宽阔背景，焦点色彩相较之下更干净、更饱和。光线均匀而温和地从正面落下，只有局部小影，没有戏剧化定向反差。低处聚集的排列在上方留下宽裕开放空间，突出俏皮的形状节奏。整体效果温暖而富动画感，由少数有力色彩重音和清楚剪影承载活力。
theme_en: Two grinning cartoon boys seated beside an orange cat on a teal ground
theme_zh: 青绿色底面上两名咧嘴笑的卡通男孩坐在橙色猫旁
name: Butch Hartman
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
